points.note: Exact source row: 'Fig 2b, mSEM Human cortex'!A2:C2. Quote columns: Reconstruction Method | Splits along axons [1/mm] | Mergers along axons [1/mm]. Test: 5 randomly/densely seeded axons, 1.4 mm path length (paper-rounded), human cortex H01 multiSEM. Human H01 (150 µm)^3 test subvolume; five separate training axons; not the 6.5-mm soma-seeded set. Source workbook columns are B=split errors/mm and C=merge errors/mm; x/y here intentionally transpose the original Figure 2b axes. Merge detection required >2.2 µm excursions from ground truth; baseline merge events weighted 0.5 per neurite; new RoboEM multiSEM mergers weighted 1. Split evaluation excludes agglomerates with ≤2.5 µm ground-truth overlap (about 90% of ground-truth path remains covered). These are operating points, not a year trend or erL/nERL values. No uncertainty interval is supplied in this source workbook. Methods: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41592-024-02226-5#Sec2
